newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean refiners update 1997 maintenance plans.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean refiners update 1997 maintenance plans.

text.p: South Korean oil refiners have updated their schedules for refinery maintenance shutdowns this year, which show a strong concentration in June and August, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy said on Thursday.
The shutdown for 1997, which is estimated at a combined 340 days, is much longer than last year's 246 days, the ministry statement said.
However, the longer shutdown this year would not create problems because of generally slow demand in June and August and overcapacity, a ministry official said.
